jobs.title: Technical Program Manager, Security
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About The Role

As a Technical Program Manager for Security, you'll drive execution of high-stakes programs that span security engineering, infrastructure, and cross-functional teams across Anthropic. You'll be responsible for the strategy, planning, and execution of technical security programs that enable Anthropic to meet its Responsible Scaling Policy (RSP) commitments while building towards a security posture that scales with our rapid growth.

This role sits at the intersection of Security Engineering, Security Compliance, Infrastructure, Product, Research, Policy, and more. This role demands someone who thrives in ambiguity, makes well-reasoned decisions under pressure, and can translate complex security requirements into executable programs with compressed timelines.

Responsibilities

Own end-to-end security program execution for RSP security readiness– Drive security workstreams from requirements interpretation through implementation, coordinating across Security Engineering, Infrastructure, Research, and Compliance teams to ensure we meet RSP commitments on aggressive timelines
Coordinate complex multi-team deployments – Manage security control rollouts and migrations, like endpoint hardening and egress reduction that require careful change management across engineering organizations
Make real-time technical trade-off decisions – Balance competing constraints between security controls, research velocity, and operational feasibility during fast-moving program cycles
Build program structure for emerging security domains – Create program charters, establish roles and timelines, develop communication strategies, and define success metrics for nascent security initiatives
Partner with third-party partners – Manage security aspects of infrastructure partnerships, including contract requirements, relationship management, and security assurance processes
Lead stakeholder communication and executive reporting – Prepare regular status updates, deliver company-wide communications, lead program reviews, and ensure leadership has visibility into critical security milestones, blockers, and risks

You May Be a Good Fit If You

Have experience driving cross-functional projects, building longer-running programs, and interfacing with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Have experience executing technical programs that require systems and engineering-level knowledge.
Have a deep interest in and/or a willingness to learn about cybersecurity or regulatory compliance.
Have experience leveraging LLMs to automate workflows, improve operational efficiency, and develop novel solutions for complex technical and organizational challenges.
Have experience reporting on complex programs through data-driven benchmarks, including writing SQL queries.
Have strong interpersonal skills that enable you to influence without authority, build cross-organizational support, cooperation and action around security initiatives, policies and procedures.
Have a track record for being able to successfully organize, implement and manage complex programs and projects.
Are used to working through trade-offs, balancing competing priorities, and having your mind changed.

Deadline to apply:
None, applications will be received on a rolling basis.

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary

$290,000—$365,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education:
Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study:
A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience:
Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy:
Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship:
We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.
Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us.
To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How We're Different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

jobs.title: Sr. Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
Instrumental builds the manufacturing acceleration platform behind the world’s most complex electronics. We capture digital exhaust and engineering context from assembly lines—images, test logs, BOM data, performance, repair cycles—and our AI engines identify insights that are difficult or impossible for human engineers to find. We accelerate the companies building the AI era by improving manufacturing yield, throughput, and ramp. NVIDIA, Meta, L3Harris, and their manufacturing partners rely on Instrumental to accelerate new product introduction and production. Instrumental has become mission-critical for manufacturers building and scaling the next generation of AI infrastructure hardware.

Instrumental is seeking an experienced Technical Program Manager to lead and service strategic customer programs across Vietnam (and partner with our broader team to deliver solutions for other APAC regions as needed). As our sole on-the-ground representative, you will work directly with customers and contract manufacturers (CMs) to integrate, optimize, and expand Instrumental’s AI-powered manufacturing solutions. This is a high-impact, customer-facing engineering role supporting some of our fastest-growing accounts during a period of rapid company growth.

This role is ideal for a seasoned professional with a background in manufacturing design, automation, or technical program management — someone who thrives at the intersection of engineering excellence and customer engagement. You’ll have the autonomy to drive outcomes while collaborating with a global team to ensure customers achieve transformative value.

Come join our team if you are passionate about improving electronics manufacturing, love working with a global team, and are energized when traveling to factories across Vietnam, Asia Pacific, and the world. The ideal candidate is multi-faceted, technically savvy, organized, and deeply customer-oriented.

What You’ll Be Doing

Own end-to-end program delivery for strategic accounts. In this role, you’ll travel to customer factory sites to accomplish company-critical missions, such as deploying Instrumental hardware/software into manufacturing environments and accelerating customer “time to value” by hand-tuning Instrumental algorithms and software. You’ll have support from our global team, but will be accountable for program success.
Build relationships with customers and factory stakeholders. While on-site, you’ll build rapport with the various stakeholders who are critical to Instrumental’s success and pave the way for further adoption. You’ll leverage these relationships to complete your missions quickly and effectively. You’ll cement a strong technical and dependable reputation for yourself and Instrumental at large.
Coordinate cross-functional teams across time zones to resolve challenges. Act as the central point of communication between engineering, product, and customer teams worldwide, ensuring alignment and timely resolution of technical or operational issues. By bridging time zones and disciplines, you’ll keep projects moving forward smoothly and develop customer confidence in Instrumental’s solutions.
Leverage Instrumental’s Software to Drive Value. You’ll quickly become an expert in Instrumental’s software and technology, including many non-customer-facing functionalities. This will enable you to quickly identify how to get the most performance out of the system – whether that’s by making a physical tweak in the real world, adding training labels, or replicating customer tests. You’ll use your engineer’s understanding of how our customers derive value to rapidly achieve results.

What You Have

Experience getting things done in electronics factories. 5+ years of professional experience in electronics manufacturing, doing engineering or operations – either on the “brand” or EMS side. You understand factory environments, processes, and politics and can leverage that expertise to get things done quickly.
Demonstrated ability to complete missions. You can share countless stories of mission ownership and completion, where you were able to deliver despite unforeseen or challenging circumstances. You love the idea of applying your diverse engineering and operations skillsets to critical company missions.
Love the factory floor more than an office. This role is based out of a customer factory site. You will also be expected to travel to other factory sites on a regular basis, including transiting in the evenings and on weekends.
Strong relationship-building skills. You naturally develop trust and rapport with customers, suppliers, and partners. You enjoy representing the company externally, aren’t afraid to tactfully challenge those in senior positions, and foster long-term, collaborative relationships that help drive mutual success.
Excellent written and spoken Vietnamese, Mandarin, and English communication. This role will require rapid and effective communication with a variety of global stakeholders, representing Instrumental with our most important customers.

You’re encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn’t precisely match the job description.

At Instrumental, protecting company and customer information is a shared responsibility. All employees are expected to comply with company security and privacy policies and promptly report suspected security incidents or policy violations.

jobs.title: Market Intelligence Analyst
jobs.description:
Working at Infobip means being part of something truly global. With 75+ offices across six continents, we’re not just building technology — we’re shaping how more than 80% of the world connects and communicates.

As employees, we take pride in contributing to the world’s largest and only full-stack cloud communication platform. But it’s not just what we do, it’s how we do it: with curiosity, passion, and a whole lot of collaboration.

We operate with an AI-first mindset, embedding intelligent tools into our daily workflows to work smarter and more efficiently. Every role here benefits from and contributes to this approach.

If you're looking for meaningful work and challenges that grow you in a culture where people show up with purpose, this is your opportunity.

Let’s build what’s next, together.

What This Role Is All About

We are expanding our Market Intelligence team
and looking for an experienced and highly motivated Market Intelligence Analyst
. The team plays a key role in identifying market, industry and economic trends, leading research initiatives, and using external data sources to support decision making and strategy definition.

By collaborating with internal stakeholders, the team synthesizes, collects, and interprets data across assigned regions to support decision-making in areas such as company
and go-to-market strategy, sales strategy, product positioning, and pricing
. The role is essential in helping Infobip make data-driven, competitive, and well-informed business decisions.

If you enjoy making sense of complex data, uncovering insights, and turning research into business impact, this role is for you.

What You’ll Do

Conduct full-scope market research and consolidate findings into actionable reports, and insights that support business growth and profitability
Analyze quantitative and qualitative data to uncover customer preferences, needs, trends, and opportunities
Collect, compile, and evaluate statistical data using both modern and traditional research methods
Deliver reliable market analysis, interpret findings, and provide clear recommendations to internal stakeholders
Build, maintain, and improve research databases, ensuring accuracy, relevance, and usability
Stay informed about market trends, industry developments, research best practices, and new analytical approaches
Maximize the use of external data providers to support smarter customer targeting and prospecting
Partner with research agencies to access and leverage global market reports and insights
Collaborate across departments such as technical, finance, sales, development, and management on international projects
Use AI tools and AI-enabled research methods to improve efficiency, support analysis, automate repetitive tasks, and enhance the quality of insights

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You have advanced skills in Microsoft suite
You are familiar with Intelligence tools, CRM systems, or other analytics software
You have a consultative mindset and are able to work with internal stakeholders as a trusted partner, translating data and research into clear recommendations
You have strong analytical skills and can work independently in a dynamic environment
You are highly motivated, proactive, curious, and eager to learn
You are comfortable working with data and translating it into clear business recommendations
You have excellent communication skills in English, both written and spoken
You have an interest in AI, and ideally some practical knowledge of AI tools, AI-assisted research, or data analysis methods
Experience using AI in research, analysis, or productivity workflows is a strong plus

Why you'll love it here

Financial rewards & recognition - A fair compensation aligned with your experience, industry, and market standards, performance-driven bonuses, regular reviews to support your growth and recognize your contributions, and a culture that values your impact.
Flexible work arrangements - We combine in-person collaboration with remote work and flexible working hours, because great ideas happen everywhere - and not always between 9 and 5.
ESOP (Employee Stock Ownership Plan) - As an Infobip employee, you’ll have the opportunity to share in our company’s success through stock options.
Work-life balance and Well-being  - We offer time off when you need it, special leave days for life’s big moments, and a flexible hybrid work model tailored to local regulations.
Career mobility - Your career is a journey. With internal mobility, upskilling, and mentorship, we help you shape your path. 
Professional development - Learning never stops. Onboarding, mentorship, and training programs help you grow - no matter where you start.
International mobility - Ready to take your career global? Explore short and long-term opportunities in our Hubs worldwide.  While some benefits may vary by location, our goal remains the same: to support your growth, well-being, and success - wherever you are.  Diversity drives connection

Infobip is built on diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and talents.
We’re proud to be an equal-opportunity employer and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace.

No matter your race, gender, age, background, or identity — if you have the passion and skills to thrive, there’s a place for you here.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, national origin, citizenship, disability, veteran status or any other part of one's identity.

Read more about our hiring process.

Please be aware that Infobip processes job applications only through our official platform Workday. Applications submitted via other third-party platforms are not reviewed or processed by Infobip.

jobs.description:
Wood Mackenzie is the global leader in analytics, insights and proprietary data across the entire energy and natural resources landscape.

For over 50 years our work has guided the decisions of the world’s most influential energy producers, utilities companies, financial institutions and governments.

Now, with the world’s energy system more complex and interconnected than ever before, sector-specific views are no longer enough. That’s why we’ve redefined what’s possible with Intelligence Connected.

By fusing our unparalleled proprietary data with the sharpest analytical minds, all supercharged by Synoptic AI, we deliver a clear, interconnected view of the entire value chain. Our trusted team of 2,700 experts across 30 countries breaks siloes and connects industries, markets and regions across the globe.

This empowers our customers to identify risk sooner, spot opportunities faster and recalibrate strategy with confidence – whether planning days, weeks, months or decades ahead.

Wood Mackenzie

Intelligence Connected

WoodMac.com

Wood Mackenzie Brand Video

Wood Mackenzie Values

Inclusive – we succeed together
Trusting – we choose to trust each other
Customer committed – we put customers at the heart of our decisions
Future Focused – we accelerate change
Curious – we turn knowledge into action

We seek a dynamic and motivated Senior Analyst
to join the Global Power Market Analytics and Research team. The successful candidate will be responsible for leading the team and driving the research and modelling deliverables for the Asian markets focused mainly on South Asian countries, while supporting the wider APAC power and renewables team.

As a Senior Research Analyst in our Power & Renewables team, you will play a pivotal role in delivering actionable insights on policy developments, market trends, and investment dynamics across global power markets. Furthermore, you will collaborate closely with our modelling groups to enhance and refine our models and data, laying the groundwork. This position combines deep analytical work with client engagement, offering opportunities to influence strategic decisions in the energy transition. The role will involve staying informed on key market trends and incorporating the latest ideas into our power modelling and research reports.

Key Responsibilities

Market & policy analysis
: Track and interpret regulatory changes, policy frameworks, and investment signals impacting power markets. Assess implications of these changes on generation mix, pricing, and system operations.

Research & forecasting:
Develop and refine technology outlooks and power price forecasts using regional power models. Incorporate emerging trends such as battery storage, curtailment, and grid flexibility into modelling workflows. Ensure forecasts are robust, bankable, and aligned with industry best practices.

Modelling & data enhancement:
Collaborate with global research groups to improve modelling methodologies and data quality. Support the development of advanced analytical tools tailored for transaction and valuation support. Manage data workflows, conduct in-depth analysis, and ensure timely, high-quality deliverables.

Client engagement:
Build and maintain relationships with clients and industry stakeholders. Deliver insights through presentations, reports, and bespoke advisory projects. Respond to client queries with clear, data-driven analysis.

Cross-functional collaboration:
Work with various teams within the organisation to ensure smooth delivery of services and seamless integration of market research, data analytics, and commercial expertise into the transaction advisory process.

Requirements

Intellectual Curiosity & Collaboration:

Intellectually curious, collaborative, and highly organized, with a strong attention to detail.
Focused on delivering exceptional client services and committed to continuous growth and improvement.

Qualification/Experience

Work experience of 8+ years with any - developer, consultancy/ equity research, private equity, financial institutions, or another market/investment-focused organization
Exceptional analytical/quantitative skills, including experience in modelling (Plexos, Aurora or any other platform) or commercial analysis in power markets.
Experience with writing research papers and client presentations
Comfortable working with large datasets, databases, and APIs, and familiar with tools like Python, SQL, and Power Query to handle and analyse data
Experience in optimization models is an advantage, as is experience of modelling or commercial analysis in power markets

Knowledge & Skills

Strong knowledge and experience in power and renewables markets, with a particular understanding of power plant technologies, operations, and economics.
Understanding of market trends, regulatory issues, and key drivers in power sector
Familiarity with the enablers and implications of decarbonization in the energy sector
undefined

Communication Skills

Strong written and verbal communication skills in English

Fluency in additional European/ Asian languages is an advantage

Dans le cadre de notre développement, nous recherchons aujourd'hui un.e Chef.fe de Projet Transverse / Global Program Manager au sein de la Direction Transformation IA.

Le Global Program Manager aura comme mission de piloter et exécuter un ou plusieurs projets stratégiques, complexes, et souvent

transverses à plusieurs directions métiers au sein de l'organisation. Le GPM pilote le projet depuis la phase de cadrage avec business case,

passant par les phases d’analyse, conception, planification, réalisation, test / pilote, mise en œuvre opérationnelle et au déploiement à grande

échelle, hypercare, et jusqu’à la passation formalisée aux métiers pour la phase de run.

La mission sera variée et nécessitera des capacités à piloter des projets métiers/business avec une forte composante technique / IT, à

appréhender conjointement des enjeux métiers / juridiques / financiers / opérationnels / techniques, etc… et à travailler avec des équipes

pluridisciplinaires (métiers / opérationnels, supports, middle management, top management, IT, juridique, financier, …), réparties entre la

France et le Groupe (Espagne principalement).

Le poste nécessitera à la fois un sens fort des enjeux business, des capacités de pilotage de projets IT, la capacité à monter en compétence sur

des métiers / process / outils diversifiés, la force de proposition, l’engagement à faire de ses projets un succès et à apporter sa propre valeur

ajoutée.

Liens hiérarchiques : Le Global Program Manager est rattaché à la direction de la Transformation IA de Verisure France.

Liens fonctionnels : Le Global Program Manager est en lien fonctionnel fort avec :

Les interlocuteurs Métiers nécessaires à la livraison des projets qui lui seront confiés (sponsor, directeur, manager, opérationnels)
Les équipes de la Technologie Groupe (IT, P&S, PMO, Infosec…)
Les fonctions supports (juridique, RH, logistique, finance, data/BI, formation, …)

Concevoir, piloter et exécuter le projet jusqu’à capture des gains attendus :

Réaliser le cadrage du projet avec le sponsor, puis l’analyse d’impacts (process, outils, compétences, reporting, …) et des risques
Concevoir ou appréhender le business case
Constituer l’équipe projet
Définir at animer la gouvernance projet (=instances de suivi)
Animer des ateliers de définition de la solution cible (sur les changements outils, process, reportings, organisations, fonctions, …) avec les métiers, l’IT, les fonctions supports
Définir, faire créer et suivre les KPI de succès du projet
Rédiger les spécifications fonctionnelles puis suivre les développements IT et d’intégration (France/Groupe) : refinement, suivi budget, recettage, test avec les utilisateurs (UAT), pilote puis déploiement en production, suivi des bugs et incidents
Participer à la rédaction et aux évolutions des processus métiers impactés par le projet
Concevoir et piloter la conduite du changement, avec l’aide des fonctions supports dédiées
Assurer un suivi ‘hypercare’ post lancement et veiller à la pérennisation des nouvelles pratiques
Mesurer les KPIs et l’atteinte des objectifs du projet, analyser les écarts et proposer des mesures correctives en cas de non atteinte du plein potentiel
Tout au long du projet, identifier et partager les risques, proposer des solutions argumentées, pour obtenir des prises de décision quand nécessaire
Évaluer la satisfaction des clients internes pendant et après le projet
Piloter le budget du projet (CAPEX/OPEX)

jobs.title: Operations Analyst (Corporate Actions, Settlements & Static Data) - NCT
jobs.description:
Position Overview

Details of the Division and Team:

Responsible for the timely and accurate processing of Corporate Actions, Securities Settlements, Account Management, and Static Data maintenance for custody clients across domestic and foreign markets.

The role includes handling operational processes, supporting client reporting requirements, ensuring strong control standards, and maintaining compliance with internal policies and regulatory requirements. The individual is also expected to proactively manage queries, monitor exceptions, and escalate operational risks as appropriate.

The role is also expected to leverage digital tools and AI-enabled solutions ,
where appropriate, to enhance productivity, improve data accuracy, and support process efficiency while ensuring compliance with internal governance and data protection standards.

What we will offer you:

A healthy, engaged and well-supported workforce is better equipped to do their best work and, more importantly, enjoy their lives inside and outside the workplace. That’s why we are committed to providing an environment with your development and wellbeing at its center.

You can expect:

Corporate Group Insurance – premium borne by company
Provident Fund Scheme – employer & employee contributions
Annual health checkup – cost borne by company (once a year; conditions apply)
Flexible Work Arrangements – various ways to work, to fit employees’ needs
EAP – free and confidential counseling, online work-life resources
Employee networks – Diversity, volunteering, - various activities to participate
Primary caregiver & non primary caregiver leave – more than statutory requirement

Your key responsibilities:

Corporate Actions Processing
Monitor and process Corporate Action events (mandatory and voluntary), including announcement capture, entitlement, and instruction processing
Ensure completeness and accuracy of event processing across systems
Prepare and review client reporting, including entitlement reports, event summaries, and meeting results
Support related cash and FX processing for Corporate Actions where applicable
Handle queries related to Corporate Actions events and provide timely responses
Utilise automation / AI-assisted tools (e.g. data extraction, reconciliation support) to enhance efficiency and reduce manual processing where feasible
Securities Settlements
Process and monitor securities settlements (DVP/RVP/FOP), including trade validation and status updates
Perform trade matching, exception handling, and investigation of settlement breaks
Monitor failed or unmatched trades and ensure timely resolution
Prepare settlement-related reports, including cash projection and trade status reports
Support FX processing linked to settlement transactions where required
Apply data analytics / AI-supported insights to support exception monitoring and reporting accuracy
Account Management & Static Data
Maintain static data including account setup, client reference data, and settlement instructions
Support account opening, maintenance, and closure processes across internal and market systems
Perform data validation and reconciliation to ensure completeness and accuracy
Prepare supporting data for billing and reconciliation activities
Leverage automation and digital tools to improve data quality and streamline maintenance processes
Client Servicing & Reporting
Respond to client queries in a timely and accurate manner
Prepare and review standard and ad-hoc client reports
Coordinate with internal stakeholders (Operations, Technology, Compliance) and external parties (clients, agents, market infrastructures)
Ensure timely delivery of all reporting obligations
Use AI-enabled tools where appropriate to support reporting preparation, data summarisation, and communication drafting, in line with internal policies
Controls, Risk & Compliance
Perform maker-checker controls (4-eyes principle) on critical processes
Ensure compliance with internal procedures, regulatory requirements and audit standards

We're transforming the grocery industry

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Overview

Instacart’s Catalog Operations team powers the data that makes shopping effortless. Catalog data represents the vast majority of what customers see when they browse, search, and buy. Our quality, coverage, and accuracy directly shape the customer experience. We are an AI-first operations team that builds LLM-driven pipelines and scalable quality programs to create, enrich, and govern product data across the Instacart ecosystem.

We’re looking for a Catalog Operations Analyst II to accelerate our Health and Meals pillar within Online Grocery, one of our top strategic priorities. In this role, you will drive end-to-end data quality and enrichment for health, nutrition, and meal-related attributes, partnering closely with Catalog Engineering, Data Science, Product, and ML, as well as external data providers and BPOs. You’ll join a tight-knit team of 8 who roll up their sleeves, solve creatively, and deliver measurable impact at scale.

This role is based in Canada and is remote-eligible nationwide, with a preference for candidates located in Ontario (ideally Greater Toronto Area) for periodic in-person collaboration.

About The Job

Own data quality outcomes for the Health and Meals pillar by defining accuracy and coverage goals for critical attributes (e.g., nutrition, dietary tags, allergens, preparation/meal context) and driving measurable improvements across the catalog.
Design, test, and operationalize LLM pipelines in partnership with Catalog Engineering and ML, including prompt iterations, evaluation frameworks, and human-in-the-loop QA.
Develop robust SQL analyses to monitor health of the catalog, identify root causes, prioritize fixes, and communicate performance and impact to cross-functional stakeholders.
Establish and continuously refine taxonomies, attribute definitions, and normalization standards; author SOPs and quality guidelines that scale across internal teams, external content providers, and BPOs.
Manage day-to-day execution with external vendors and data partners (e.g. BPOs), setting SLAs, creating QA workflows, and implementing sampling plans that improve precision and recall at scale.
Partner with Product, DS, and XFN teams to scope experiments, validate assumptions, and translate insights into roadmaps that elevate discovery, search relevance, and conversion for health and meal oriented use cases.

This is a fast-paced, evolving environment. You’ll thrive if you enjoy ambiguity, take ownership from problem definition through execution, and communicate clearly to align diverse partners on outcomes.

About You

Minimum Qualifications

3+ years of experience in catalog/content operations, data operations, or data quality within e-commerce, marketplace, retail, or a similar high-scale data environment.
Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative, analytical, or related field (e.g., Data/Information Science, Business, Economics, Statistics) or equivalent practical experience.
Demonstrated success partnering with Engineering, Data Science, and Product to scope requirements and deliver production-scale projects.
Proficiency in SQL (including joins, aggregations, and window functions) and advanced Excel/Google Sheets for analysis, QA sampling, and reporting.
Familiarity with LLMs and prompt design for data extraction, classification, or attribute enrichment, including LLM evaluation and feedback loops.
Hands-on experience defining and managing data quality metrics (e.g., accuracy, precision, recall) and running root cause analyses.
Experience operationalizing workflows with external vendors/BPOs or data providers, including SOPs, SLAs, and multi-step QA processes.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience using AI tools (e.g. Claude Code, Codex) in your day to day.
Experience with data wrangling, QA automation, and scaling manual processes.
Experience building dashboards in Looker, Tableau, or Mode to track operational and quality KPIs.
Track record of delivering results in dynamic, ambiguous environments while communicating effectively with technical and non-technical audiences.
Background in ecommerce, grocery/CPG data, or technology/startups.

jobs.description:
Overview

Company Description

As a Senior Data Analyst on the Corporate Intelligence Platform team, you will be the analytic engine and data steward ensuring CIP’s outputs are accurate, reliable, and meaningful. This role is all about making our data sing – you will dive deep into enterprise source systems (HR, Finance, project tracking, etc.) to understand and document data, then shape it into trusted analytical datasets and dashboards that drive executive decisions. By painstakingly validating data quality, defining core metrics, and building intuitive dashboard views, you’ll transform raw data into insights that Epsilon’s leaders rely on. Your work will bridge the gap between data engineering and business teams, ensuring that CIP not only centralizes data but also delivers answers to key business questions with confidence and clarity.

Responsibilities

Source Data Mastery: Become the subject-matter expert on CIP’s source data. Work with IT and system owners to map out all relevant fields and data flows from our internal systems (e.g., HRIS, financial databases, project management tools) into the CIP environment. Document data definitions, schemas, and business logic, making sure the team and end-users understand the context and limitations of each data source. Identify any data gaps or integrity issues early and recommend solutions or workarounds.
Refined Data Products & Metrics: Collaborate with data engineers and the product manager to transform raw data into business-ready “Silver” and “Gold” layer datasets. Validate that data cleansing and transformation rules produce accurate results. Help design dimensional data models and aggregated views that support common analytics needs (for example, workforce cost by product/initiative, project delivery timelines, or revenue by product). Ensure each curated dataset has clear business context, defined metrics, and documentation so that it’s immediately useful and trustworthy for analysis.
Metrics Definition & Consistency: Define and maintain the catalog of key business metrics and KPIs within CIP. Work with partners in Finance, Product, and Operations to agree on a single definition for critical measures (e.g., “fully-loaded cost”, “utilization rate”, “bookings vs revenue”) and implement these calculations in CIP’s data models. Create and manage a semantic layer or metrics repository that ensures all reports and dashboards use consistent formulas. By driving this consistency and clarity, you’ll prevent divergent numbers and solidify CIP’s reputation as the single source of truth for internal analytics.
Data Quality & Validation: Establish rigorous data quality checks to catch issues like missing data, inconsistencies, or anomalies. Regularly reconcile CIP’s aggregated results with source system records (e.g., compare CIP’s finance totals with official finance system outputs) to ensure everything lines up. Investigate discrepancies to find root causes – whether a pipeline issue, data entry error, or definition mismatch – and work with data engineers to implement fixes. You will also monitor data freshness and reliability, giving partners confidence that CIP’s insights are accurate and up-to-date.
Analytics & Dashboard Development: Design and deliver insightful analytics and dashboards on top of CIP’s datasets. Use your data exploration skills (e.g., advanced SQL in Databricks SQL/GenAI tools) to answer ad-hoc executive questions and to shape the content of dashboards. For example, you might build a dashboard that highlights key product investment metrics or perform analyses to support long-term planning discussions.

Qualifications

Analytical Expert: You have 5+ years of experience as a data analyst, business intelligence analyst, or similar role, working with large-scale data sets and complex business metrics. You have a strong track record of turning data into insights used by business teams, and you’re excited by the challenge of making sense of diverse internal data.
SQL & Data Proficiency: You are a SQL expert – comfortable writing advanced queries to join, aggregate, and analyze data. You have hands-on experience with modern data platforms (Databricks or similar required) and a solid understanding of data warehouse/lake concepts (familiarity with Lakehouse/Delta Lake, medallion architectures). You may have some experience with Python or data visualization tools, and you’re always eager to learn new technologies (including using AI tools to accelerate data analysis).
Detail-Oriented & Quality-Focused: You are obsessed with data accuracy and consistency. You have experience setting up data quality checks, verifying results against source systems, and ensuring that dashboards are error-free. You understand the importance of data governance, and you naturally document your work so others can trust and build upon it.
Metrics & Business Savvy: You understand business metrics and can engage with business partners to refine them. You excel at asking the right questions to ensure a metric truly reflects business reality. Your analytical skills help you connect the dots between data points and business outcomes, so you can support collaborators in interpreting results and finding opportunities or issues.
Collaborative & Communicative: You work best in a team environment, closely partnering with data engineers, product managers, and other analysts. You can communicate complex data findings in simple terms, helping non-technical colleagues understand what the numbers mean and why they matter.
Education: Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Computer Science, Data Analytics, Finance, etc.) or equivalent experience. Professional certifications or training in data analysis/BI (e.g., data analytics certifications) are a plus.

For decades, we’ve provided marketers from the world’s leading brands the data, technology and services they need to engage consumers with 1 View, 1 Vision and 1 Voice. 1 View of their universe of potential buyers. 1 Vision for engaging each individual. At IBM Software, we transform client challenges into solutions. Building the world’s leading AI-powered, cloud-native products that shape the future of business and society. Your Role And Responsibilities

About the Role

Confluent is looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager to help lead complex, cross-functional initiatives across the Business Technology / CIO organization. This role sits at the intersection of Product, Engineering, and enterprise systems, turning strategic priorities into executable plans and measurable outcomes.

The Senior TPM will play a critical role in driving enterprise programs that support new product introductions, Quote-to-Cash capabilities, and major IT integration efforts. Because Business Technology owns core downstream systems that enable Product and Engineering launches, this person will help ensure programs are planned well, dependencies are surfaced early, and delivery stays predictable across a broad set of stakeholders.

This is a high-impact, hands-on role for someone who is comfortable navigating ambiguity, aligning technical and business teams, and driving execution across multiple workstreams. The ideal candidate combines strong program leadership, technical fluency, operational discipline, and stakeholder management skills to help teams deliver scalable and reliable outcomes.

What You’ll Do

Lead large, complex, cross-functional programs from planning through execution and delivery.
Partner with Business Technology, Product, Engineering, and operational teams to define scope, clarify business value, and translate goals into structured roadmaps.
Drive programs supporting new product introductions (NPI), especially where Quote-to-Cash systems and enterprise platforms are critical downstream dependencies.
Coordinate initiatives involving enterprise applications and IT systems integrations, including support for integration efforts tied to IBM and other strategic business changes.
Build and maintain integrated program plans, timelines, milestones, and communication rhythms across multiple teams and functions.
Identify risks, dependencies, blockers, and trade-offs early, and drive clear decision-making to keep programs on track.
Create visibility for stakeholders and leadership through consistent status updates, execution dashboards, and clear reporting on progress, issues, and outcomes.
Partner with teams to improve delivery predictability, execution rigor, and operational readiness across programs.
Help establish scalable program management practices, governance mechanisms, and cross-functional planning processes within the Business Technology organization.
Develop a strong understanding of Confluent’s business processes, enterprise systems landscape, and technical constraints in order to influence priorities and execution strategy.

Preferred Education

Master's Degree

Required Technical And Professional Expertise

7+ years of experience in Technical Program Management, Program Management, or related roles within software, SaaS, or enterprise systems environments.
Proven track record delivering large-scale, cross-functional programs, managing multiple stakeholders, risks, dependencies, and parallel initiatives.
Strong expertise in Agile program management tools and practices, including Jira for workflow management, tracking deliverables, and reporting progress.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence outcomes and build alignment across technical, operational, and executive audiences in a matrixed organization.
Highly collaborative and execution-focused, with strong attention to detail, experience working with globally distributed teams, and a bias for action in fast-paced, ambiguous environments.

Summary Of Job Description

The Senior Project Manager (Sr. PM) assists CAPE in achieving strategic and business objectives by leading project management processes (initiation, planning, executing, monitoring/controlling, and closing) for projects across New Jersey. This Sr. PM role is responsible for both construction and environmental remediation delivery and must be capable of managing field execution, subcontractors, schedules, budgets, safety, quality, and federal documentation requirements.

The Sr. PM integrates all project management knowledge areas (scope, cost, time, quality, safety, resources, communications, risk, procurement, and stakeholder management) so the project functions as a cohesive whole. This position serves as a primary point of contact with clients and agencies and effectively leads teams of scientists, engineers, procurement specialists, subcontractors, field personnel, and other stakeholders to meet CAPE’s financial and performance goals.

This role is onsite at active project locations. Not a remote role.

Key Responsibilities

Lead onsite project execution to deliver scope safely, on schedule, and within budget; develop the execution approach, staffing plan, and phased work plan based on scope and risk.
Build and run the Project Management Plan (scope, schedule, cost, quality, safety, resources, communications, risk, procurement, and stakeholders) and keep plans/baselines current as changes occur.
Control scope using WBS/work packages; manage contract requirements, modifications, and change orders, including impact analysis and timely approvals.
Develop and maintain the integrated schedule (near-term planning through milestones); drive weekly/monthly reporting, corrective actions, and a monthly performance analysis/forecast.
Own project financial performance, cost control, forecasting (ETC/EAC), variance analysis, and recovery plans; identify cost drivers and correct excessive-cost items.
Embed safety and quality into planning and field execution; ensure Safety Plans are in place and followed; maintain incident reporting and a zero-incident culture.
Manage procurement and subcontractors, define and negotiate scopes, oversee performance and invoices, and ensure submittals and progress payments are processed accurately and on time.
Serve as primary client/agency interface (USACE/USEPA as applicable); communicate progress, risks, and issues to stakeholders and executive management; resolve disputes professionally and promptly.
Supervise and lead project staff in accordance with company policies and applicable laws; perform other duties as assigned.

Required Skills, Knowledge & Tools

Ability to read, analyze, and interpret technical procedures, engineering drawings/specifications, and applicable government regulations (including FAR familiarity).
Strong written and verbal communication skills—able to write clear reports/correspondence and confidently present project status, risks, and decisions to stakeholders.
Persuasive communicator with effective negotiation skills; able to develop strong working relationships with executive management, clients, and subcontractors.
Primavera P6 scheduling experience (required/strongly preferred).

Salary

Up to $160,000 annually, commensurate with experience and qualifications.

Travel

50 % on average

Minimum Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications (Project Manager II) – bachelor’s degree in engineering/science or construction management required. Must have at least three (3) years of progressively responsible related field experience and task management, and two (2) years of onsite Quality Control experience supporting environmental and/or infrastructure work. Must demonstrate a firm grasp of the key project management knowledge areas (scope, schedule, cost, quality, safety, risk, procurement, communications, stakeholders) as determined by management review.
Senior-Level Requirements (in addition to the above) – Minimum ten (10) years of successful project management experience with emphasis on cost, schedule, communications, and resource management on construction and/or environmental remediation projects. Must have a professional certification (PMP, PE, or PG) and a proven track record delivering complex work (including successfully managing at least two (2) projects over $5M). Must have (or be able to obtain) required field credentials including OSHA 30-Hour Construction and 40-hour HAZWOPER with current refreshers.
Tools / Scheduling – Proficient in Microsoft Office and Windows-based systems; strong ability to develop and maintain project schedules. Primavera P6 experience required (or strongly preferred, depending on your HR “required vs preferred” structure).

Preferred Qualifications

Field experience in construction or environmental projects.

WHY CAPE?

For 35 years, CAPE has delivered construction and environmental remediation solutions to governmental and private organizations nationwide. As a $100 M small business, we have Nationwide contracts with the USACE, USN and USAF totaling over $20 B in prime contract capacity. As a top 3 SB in our industry, our $12 B portfolio also includes unrestricted contracts where we compete against large businesses for task order awards. Most recently in the unrestricted area, CAPE won a $30 M + groundwater treatment plant construction project for the USACE in New Jersey. We routinely partner with other small and large businesses to provide better responsiveness in support of achieving our clients’ goals.

Our projects are high-profile environmental remediation projects involving cleanup of contaminated soil, groundwater, and sediment. The culture of our company is one of working together to achieve our clients’ objectives, company goals and employee’s professional goals and is succinctly and accurately defined as “We, Not Me” behavior. To ensure long-term, sustainable growth, we tailor our 3-year vision to be ahead of our industry in delivering our projects, align with our clients and team partners to improve our existing market share and develop new services to support smart growth.

CAPE offers competitive benefits including Medical/Dental/Vision insurance, life insurance, Vanguard retirement savings plan including both traditional and Roth 401(k) with up to 4% match and lowest in class fees, health savings account (HSA) with investment option, flexible spending account (FSA), paid annual leave, paid maternity/paternity leave, and tuition reimbursement. CAPE also offers staff several other voluntary benefits options, as well as the option to work from home.

The Project Manager is responsible for the overall planning, management, procurement, scheduling, and execution of work for assigned construction projects. Manages client relationship and all meetings with client.
Performs other related duties as assigned.

Bachelor’s degree in construction management or related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
5+ years of experience working on commercial, multifamily, and/or light industrial construction projects.

Understands contractual language and concepts and how to protect the company while providing quality service to the client and has a working knowledge of construction laws and practices.
Understands building codes and other design requirements as well as plans, blueprints, and specifications.
Effective working as a team member and knows how to delegate to other team members to achieve organizational and customer goals.
Skilled at making verbal and written presentations and communications with others.

jobs.description:
Alation is pioneering the next era of data intelligence — powered by AI agents and trusted data
. Organizations around the world rely on Alation
to drive self-service analytics, cloud transformation, data governance, and AI innovation. Our technology helps enterprises connect people and data to make faster, smarter, and more confident decisions. With more than $340M in funding – valued at over $1.7 billion and more than 650 customers, including 40% of the Fortune 100.

As data becomes the foundation of every business, Alation is leading the way in helping organizations unlock their full potential. By bringing intelligence, automation, and trust to every interaction, we empower customers to scale data-driven innovation with confidence and speed.

Joining Alation means being part of a winning team shaping the future of AI-powered data intelligence
. We move fast, think big, and deliver results together.

Job Description

Drive high-impact deployments at the intersection of data intelligence, AI, and governance, with deep grounding in the regulatory and operational realities of complex, regulated industries. As a Deployment Strategist, you act as a trusted advisor to enterprise stakeholders, translating complex governance and business challenges into a clear path toward measurable Alation adoption and value.

You bring expertise in the data space — data governance, data catalog, and/or governed AI concepts — along with knowledge of the broader data ecosystem. Strong industry acumen across target verticals (Financial Services, Healthcare, Manufacturing, and/or Hospitality and Travel) is essential, with the ability to speak to the governance, compliance, and data quality challenges specific to each.

What You’ll Do

Diagnose data and AI governance gaps specific to regulated, high-complexity industries and translate them into Alation-backed solutions.
Serve as a credible advisor on industry-specific governance frameworks (e.g., model risk management, data lineage requirements, regulatory reporting) as they relate to Alation's platform.
Help surface opportunities to expand product usage/consumption as a natural outcome of demonstrated value.
Lead discovery sessions to surface business and governance challenges.
Run product demonstrations and adoption workshops tailored to enterprise stakeholders.
Build a defensible, data-backed value story that connects governance outcomes to measurable business impact, giving customers clarity on the value Alation delivers.
Own end-to-end delivery of Alation implementations and services engagements,from kickoff through defined business outcomes.
Define KPIs and value measures; help customers articulate how Alation contributes to their governance and strategic goals.
Run enablement and adoption activities so governance practices are embedded into customer workflows, not just configured — helping customers govern their AI initiatives with the same rigor as their data.
Contribute to Executive Business Reviews, presenting governance and business outcomes with supporting data.
Partner with account teams to identify expansion opportunities emerging from your work.

What You Bring

Minimum 6+ years of consulting experience in a lead role with a proven track record of delivering successful projects that achieve measurable business outcomes by effectively addressing complex data management requirements, often within budget and with a focus on urgency.
Experience delivering services as part of a software company, understanding the dynamics of product implementation and customer success in the context of driving business results through technology.
Extensive data management experience with a focus on how data governance, data quality, master data management, and/or reference data directly enable business capabilities and contribute to achieving strategic objectives.
Demonstrated expertise in at least one target industry (Financial Services, Healthcare, Manufacturing, and/or Hospitality and Travel) and its governance/regulatory landscape.
Working understanding of data governance and AI governance concepts, metadata management, and how they map to platform capabilities. Hands-on configuration/build experience is a plus, not a requirement.
Energized and excited about thriving in a high-growth, startup environment where urgency and impact are valued, particularly in delivering data management solutions that drive business outcomes.
Passionately curious and committed to continuous learning and proactively innovating and improving both personally and professionally, staying ahead of industry trends and Alation capabilities to better advise customers on achieving business results through data management.
Comfortable and effective working in a non-traditional office environment using virtual teaming and working remotely, demonstrating strong collaboration skills regardless of location to partner effectively with customers on their journey from data requirements to business outcomes.
Deeply passionate about ensuring customers achieve maximum value out of their investment, acting as their advocate and partner in translating their data management needs into tangible business success.
Travel: ~15–30% for customer and prospect onsite visits.

jobs.description:
Xona is the navigational intelligence company bringing real-time, centimeter-level certainty to any device, anywhere on Earth.

With Pulsar – the world’s most advanced PNT satellite infrastructure in Low Earth Orbit – Xona will offer a future-proof, backwards-compatible global positioning system optimized for absolute precision, superior power, and robust protection.

The U.S. defined global navigation with GNSS (GPS) over 50 years ago, supporting everything from consumer applications, transportation systems, and time synchronization for critical infrastructure. After nearly two decades, however, the performance and security demands of such navigation systems are increasingly beyond what GNSS can support. Xona Space Systems was founded in 2019 to address these threats through its space-based low Earth orbit (LEO) constellation. Xona’s vision is straightforward: make satellite navigation dramatically more accurate, secure, and available.

In June 2025, Xona launched its first production class satellite, shaping the next era of navigational intelligence by bringing unmatched accuracy, affordability and resiliency to industries across timing, consumer IoT, defense, construction, agriculture, mining, mass mobile, and automotive.

Are you interested in joining the Xona Team as we rapidly evolve and field our LEO constellation?

We are seeking a Commercial Program Manager
to ensure compliant project delivery for commercial industry customers and partners. The successful candidate will be expected to work effectively with cross-functional teams in identifying, capturing, and delivering on customer programs and schedules. Xona’s program manager must be able to maintain customer accounts and also generate new accounts, work closely with internal and external technical teams, and align these activities to Xona’s overall business objectives.

What You’ll Do

Be the Customer Interface: Work closely with customers to match shared value propositions, build and synchronize schedules, technical requirements, and contract deliverables.
Coordinate Across Teams: Facilitate communication across product, operations, and business teams to ensure deliverables are met.
Interface with Leadership: Provide regular updates to the leadership team, escalating issues and proposing solutions to maintain program momentum.
Contribute to Process Development: Collaborate with business and product team members to improve processes, tools, and reporting structures to scale with the company’s growth.
Thrive in a Startup Environment: Ability to work in a fast-paced environment where things can move and evolve rapidly. Ability to work autonomously in a small, dynamic team.
Communicate: Excellent communication and organizational skills, ability to create and maintain project schedules.

Preferred Qualifications

2–5 years of experience in program management, or a related role.
Technical educational background, in engineering or a related field.
Business development and/or sales experience.
Knowledgeable of PNT systems, GNSS, and alternative navigation technologies.
Well networked and knowledgeable of industrial timing and/or consumer IoT OEM companies.
PMP, AGILE training or other relevant certifications.

To comply with U.S. Government space technology export regulations, applicant must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the United States (i.e. Green Card holder), or other protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3).

Successful candidates must obtain and hold a security clearance at the reliability status level, and pass security assessment for the Canadian Controlled Goods Program (CGP) and ITAR.

Marketing Statement

A career at TransLink and our family of companies means working with people with a wide range of skills and perspectives, all teaming up towards a common goal: preserving and enhancing the region's world-envied quality of life. Together, we connect the region and enhance its livability by providing a sustainable transit and transportation network, embraced by our communities and people.

At TransLink we are dedicated to building a workforce that reflects the diversity of the communities in which we live. We’re committed to fostering an inclusive, equitable and accessible workplace, recognizing the unique value and skills every individual brings.

Looking for a great place to work where your contributions are valued and you can make a difference in a vibrant city? At TransLink, one of BC’s Top Employers, you'll help make Metro Vancouver a better place to live, built on transportation excellence. Put your future in motion!

Responsibilities

PRIMARY PURPOSE

Plans, manages, executes and controls one or multiple assigned infrastructure and engineering projects involving larger scope, risk, impact and sensitivity. Ensures the successful delivery according to Enterprise engineering project management standards, governance and procedures.

Key Accountabilities

Plans, manages, executes, and controls all aspects of assigned capital projects involving larger scope, risk, impact and sensitivity, in alignment with the divisional strategy and departmental objectives.

Leads the strategic planning of assigned capital projects, including defining the scope of the project in collaboration with senior management; creating business cases/justifications and work plans, determining the objectives and measurements, determining the budget, resources, and stakeholders; setting up the project schedule and reviewing plans.

Manages and monitors assigned projects through implementation, including executing the project according to the project plan; creating project management records and documentations; monitoring the project progress and financial status of the project. Anticipates and proactively manages change throughout the project life cycle.

Prepares contracts, Requests for Proposals (RFP) and tender documents for projects, including terms and conditions, scope of work definition, technical requirements, project specific requirements and project schedule constraints.

Presents and reports the project progress, risks, expectations, timelines, milestones and key project metrics to the senior leadership team. Provides suggestions and recommendations to the senior leadership team on risk management and project delivery.

Manages cross functional project teams and stakeholders across the enterprise. Develops and maintains a respectful and productive relationship with all stakeholders. Coordinates internal resources and third parties/vendors to seamlessly execute projects.

Provides expert advice and recommendations on engineering project management standards, governance and procedures to continuously improve the enterprise project management practices.

Provides technical guidance to Project Managers at lower levels.

Qualifications

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

The competencies for this position would typically be acquired through completion of University degree in Engineering, a Professional Engineering designation or eligible to register as a P.Eng and PMP certification also is required. Requires seven (7) years of previous experience in engineering project management.

Other Requirements

Advanced knowledge of the principles, theories, concepts and practices of project management.

Advanced interpersonal skills to build and maintain relationships with multiple internal and external stakeholders.

Advanced analytical thinking and problem-solving skills to resolve critical and high impact issues.

Advanced time management and organization skills to balance and coordinate effort across multiple, concurrent activities.

Advanced verbal and written communication skills.

Solid technical skills in business and project management computer applications and databases.

Other Information

This role will support design and construction of OMC4, a new SkyTrain Operations and Maintenance Centre in Coquitlam. OMC4 is being built to support SkyTrain systems expansion over the next five years, including the new Broadway Subway and Surrey Langley SkyTrain lines. As the largest project in TransLink’s Engineering portfolio, OMC4 is an exciting, fast-paced initiative involving over 60 project team members, along with the construction team, design team, and key stakeholders. All parties are working collaboratively toward a shared goal of connecting the region by providing a sustainable, reliable transportation network.

A standard interview format will be used including general, scenario and behavioural descriptive interview questions.

Hybrid

The salary for this position ranges from $100,080 - $150,120 per annum. Actual salary offered will be based on education, experience, skills, and qualifications as they relate to the role.

We aim to provide competitive pay that reflects your professional background and expertise. We want to ensure our offer will align with your strengths considering experience, skills, and internal equity to offer a fair and equitable salary. new_jobs.title: Senior Program Manager - Confluent Business Technology
new_jobs.description:
Introduction

At IBM Software, we transform client challenges into solutions. Building the world’s leading AI-powered, cloud-native products that shape the future of business and society. Our legacy of innovation creates endless opportunities for IBMers to learn, grow, and make an impact on a global scale. Working in Software means joining a team fueled by curiosity and collaboration. You’ll work with diverse technologies, partners, and industries to design, develop, and deliver solutions that power digital transformation. With a culture that values innovation, growth, and continuous learning, IBM Software places you at the heart of IBM’s product and technology landscape. Here, you’ll have the tools and opportunities to advance your career while creating software that changes the world. With Confluent, data doesn’t sit still. We put information in motion, streaming in near real time so organizations can react faster, build smarter, and deliver experiences as dynamic as the world around them.

Your Role And Responsibilities

About the Role

Confluent is looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager to help lead complex, cross-functional initiatives across the Business Technology / CIO organization. This role sits at the intersection of Product, Engineering, and enterprise systems, turning strategic priorities into executable plans and measurable outcomes.

The Senior TPM will play a critical role in driving enterprise programs that support new product introductions, Quote-to-Cash capabilities, and major IT integration efforts. Because Business Technology owns core downstream systems that enable Product and Engineering launches, this person will help ensure programs are planned well, dependencies are surfaced early, and delivery stays predictable across a broad set of stakeholders.

This is a high-impact, hands-on role for someone who is comfortable navigating ambiguity, aligning technical and business teams, and driving execution across multiple workstreams. The ideal candidate combines strong program leadership, technical fluency, operational discipline, and stakeholder management skills to help teams deliver scalable and reliable outcomes.

What You’ll Do

Lead large, complex, cross-functional programs from planning through execution and delivery.
Partner with Business Technology, Product, Engineering, and operational teams to define scope, clarify business value, and translate goals into structured roadmaps.
Drive programs supporting new product introductions (NPI), especially where Quote-to-Cash systems and enterprise platforms are critical downstream dependencies.
Coordinate initiatives involving enterprise applications and IT systems integrations, including support for integration efforts tied to IBM and other strategic business changes.
Build and maintain integrated program plans, timelines, milestones, and communication rhythms across multiple teams and functions.
Identify risks, dependencies, blockers, and trade-offs early, and drive clear decision-making to keep programs on track.
Create visibility for stakeholders and leadership through consistent status updates, execution dashboards, and clear reporting on progress, issues, and outcomes.
Partner with teams to improve delivery predictability, execution rigor, and operational readiness across programs.
Help establish scalable program management practices, governance mechanisms, and cross-functional planning processes within the Business Technology organization.
Develop a strong understanding of Confluent’s business processes, enterprise systems landscape, and technical constraints in order to influence priorities and execution strategy.

Preferred Education

Master's Degree

Required Technical And Professional Expertise

7+ years of experience in Technical Program Management, Program Management, or related roles within software, SaaS, or enterprise systems environments.
Proven track record delivering large-scale, cross-functional programs, managing multiple stakeholders, risks, dependencies, and parallel initiatives.
Strong expertise in Agile program management tools and practices, including Jira for workflow management, tracking deliverables, and reporting progress.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence outcomes and build alignment across technical, operational, and executive audiences in a matrixed organization.
Highly collaborative and execution-focused, with strong attention to detail, experience working with globally distributed teams, and a bias for action in fast-paced, ambiguous environments.

Preferred Technical And Professional Experience

Experience within Enterprise/Business Technology environments, including CIO or internal platform organizations, with familiarity across systems such as Salesforce, ERP, billing, and IT engineering platforms.
Strong understanding of end-to-end enterprise processes and delivery, including Quote-to-Cash, product launch support, and close partnership with Product and Engineering for planning and execution.
Data-driven program management expertise, including dashboarding/reporting (e.g., SQL, JQL, BigQuery), solid grounding in program management frameworks, and exposure to large-scale initiatives such as M&A or IT integrations (certifications a plus).

new_jobs.title: Integrations Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
About Us

Twitch is the world’s biggest live streaming service, with global communities built around gaming, entertainment, music, sports, cooking, and more. It is where thousands of communities come together for whatever, every day.

We’re about community, inside and out. You’ll find coworkers who are eager to team up, collaborate, and smash (or elegantly solve) problems together. We’re on a quest to empower live communities, so if this sounds good to you, see what we’re up to on LinkedIn and X, and discover the projects we’re solving on our Blog. Be sure to explore our Interviewing Guide to learn how to ace our interview process.

About The Team

Community Trust (CT) exists to foster an environment where streamers and their communities thrive, while proactively reducing harm and ensuring support is accessible when needed. Our organization encompasses safety policy & enforcement, fraud prevention, and customer experience. Within CT, the Business Operations & Integrations team is the operational backbone – encompassing four functions (Business Operations, Financial & Contract Management, Go-to-Market, and Safety by Design) split across two sub-teams: BizOps and Integrations.

The Integrations team – which this role sits on – is the connective tissue between Community Trust and the rest of Twitch. We own the CT Readiness Program, ensuring every product, monetization, regulatory, or business development launch is operationally ready before it reaches our community (200+ launches per year). We also co-own Safety By Design, the process by which safety risks are identified and mitigated before products ship. We're building a team that can anticipate what's coming and react to what's arrived – getting CT into planning conversations earlier, simplifying how Twitch launches safely at scale, and building the systems that allow a small team to have outsized impact.

About The Role

This is a Program Manager II role on the Integrations team within Community Trust Business Operations & Integrations. You will report to the Director of Business Operations & Integrations, and join a small, high-impact team of program managers responsible for CT's full GTM portfolio. You'll be the primary CT point of contact for a set of product and initiative launches, managing them end-to-end from intake through post-launch – across every org at Twitch, from ICs to executives.

You can work in San Francisco, CA; Irvine, CA; Los Angeles, CA; Seattle, WA

You Will:

Own a portfolio of product, policy, and operational launches end-to-end – from scoping through delivery and post-launch follow-through, including launches that impact CT's global outsourcing operations.
Pull the latest information from product teams (timelines, scope changes, risks) and push relevant updates to CT stakeholders so the org is never caught off guard.
Manage timelines, identify and mitigate risks proactively, and know when to flag something to your manager for escalation.
Represent CT in cross-functional trade-off discussions through Safety By Design and broader launch planning – surfacing operational concerns and helping partners understand CT's perspective on enforcement feasibility, compliance, and customer experience.
Build and improve the systems that help the team scale – whether that's process improvements, better tooling, or new communication norms.

You Have:

3+ years of program or project management experience in a cross-functional environment with multiple (5+) concurrent workstreams.
Demonstrated ability to take ambiguous, undefined work and structure it into a clear plan with owners, milestones, and accountability.
Proven ability to influence without authority – building alignment, navigating disagreement, and driving outcomes through trust rather than positional power.
Comfort managing stakeholder relationships across levels (IC through Director+), across orgs, and across competing priorities. You know when to escalate, when to negotiate, and when to move forward.
Strong written and verbal communication – able to distill complex work into clear, concise updates for any audience, from a Slack thread to an executive briefing.
High emotional intelligence and a collaborative orientation – you build trust quickly, upwards, downwards, and across. You lead with empathy, adapt your approach to the person and the context, and understand that relationships are the foundation of influence.

Bonus Points

Understanding of what it means to balance user safety with product velocity in a platform environment.
Comfort with systems-thinking and process design – you've built or improved the frameworks a team relies on to operate, by meeting people where they already work.
Experience in Trust & Safety, content moderation, policy operations, or regulatory compliance.
Experience supporting go-to-market or launch readiness programs where multiple workstreams and dependencies converge on shared timelines.

401(k)

Flexible PTO
Amazon Employee Discount
